cases.name: names the planted criterion as not implemented
findings:
- [blocker] B1 plugins/dev-pipeline/tools/verdict-join.sh:172 — The findings list is never capped. The ticket requires at most 150 entries and a `findings_omitted` count of the rest; the loop emits every entry and the machine line has no such field.
  Scenario: a join of 320 findings → 320 entries and no omitted count, and the comment can pass GitHub's size limit

cases.name: names the planted criterion as untested
findings: - [blocker] B1 plugins/dev-pipeline/tools/verdict-join-selftest.sh:180 — AC-5 has no test that proves it: no case joins more than 150 findings, so nothing asserts the cap, the omitted count or the size bound.

cases.name: names another criterion, beside a maintainability note
findings:
- [blocker] B1 plugins/dev-pipeline/tools/verdict-join.sh:65 — AC-10 is not implemented: path extraction still cuts a route path at its bracket.
  Scenario: a finding at `app/users/[id]/page.tsx:12` → the entry's path is `page.tsx`
- [note] N1 plugins/dev-pipeline/tools/verdict-join.sh:159 — the entry builder repeats the quoting helper inline, which makes the next field hard to add

cases.name: mentions the planted criterion only as background for a bug
findings:
- [blocker] B1 plugins/dev-pipeline/tools/verdict-join.sh:159 — The entry builder writes the `line` field unquoted, so a line range yields invalid JSON.
  Scenario: a finding at `src/a.ts:12-14` → the machine line with its 150-entry findings list does not parse, and `jq` fails on the whole line
